author: VivekGRamaswamy
text: Apoorva headed straight from the First Lady Luncheon at the Ohio Agricultural Center to the hospital to help teach surgical techniques. Incredible to see her balance being an incredible wife & mother with being a doctor who saves lives, cares for patients, and now prepares with us to lead Ohio. ❤️
